description: o1-mini is a smaller, faster, and more cost-effective version of o1-preview. It is optimized for coding, math, and science tasks where broad world knowledge is not required. It is 80% cheaper than o1-preview while maintaining strong reasoning capabilities.

architecture.reasoningTokens: Uses internal chain-of-thought tokens (not visible to user)

trainingData.description: Trained using reinforcement learning for chain-of-thought reasoning, with emphasis on STEM domains.

trainingProcedure: Trained similarly to o1-preview but optimized for efficiency. Uses internal chain-of-thought reasoning optimized for STEM tasks.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Performs comparably to o1-preview on coding and math benchmarks while being significantly faster and cheaper. Particularly strong on competitive programming and mathematical reasoning.

knownLimitations: Higher latency than GPT-4o due to reasoning process
No image or audio input support
No function calling or structured outputs
May underperform on tasks requiring world knowledge

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: OpenAI has implemented safety measures optimized for STEM domains.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Data sent to the API may be used to improve the model unless opted out.

access.rateLimits: More restricted than GPT-4o but less than o1-preview
